_comment: Client-specified destination order. Preserve guest facial identity; transform clothing, hairstyles and accessories as a complete regional ensemble.

destinations.label: Canarias
destinations.costumePrompt: Use the supplied CANARIAS clothing panel: white puff-sleeve blouse, black bodice with colourful embroidered edging and red lacing, white lace apron over a long narrow-striped multicolour skirt; OR white collared shirt, black waistcoat with red/green embroidery, red woven sash, black knee breeches and cream gaiters. These are clothing design cues from the client’s reference, rendered as photorealistic garments with real fabric texture. Choose an appropriate dress or trouser option and honor an explicit visitor preference; never copy the reference people, change the guest’s face/body or sexualize the outfit. No baseball or sports uniforms.
destinations.scenePrompt: Canary Islands photographic travel postcard scene: Tenerife’s distinctive Mount Teide volcanic summit and lava landscape, Atlantic blue water and subtropical island light. Use Tenerife as the specific scenic inspiration for Canarias; do not invent a coastline combining distant islands. No Santiago cathedral or mainland Spanish landmarks.
destinations.hairPrompt: DRESS ensemble: arrange the hair in a tidy traditional low bun or gathered braids beneath the reference straw hat and light cream head cloth/veil; keep the face open and clearly recognizable. TROUSER ensemble: include the reference black felt hat with neatly arranged hair. Match the selected Canarian reference outfit, not another region.

destinations.hairPrompt: DRESS / CHULAPA ensemble: hair MUST be gathered into a neat low bun, with a white triangular pañuelo/headscarf over the head and tied beneath the chin, and a clearly visible RED ROSE pinned at the front/side of the scarf beside the hair. The client specifically requests a rose. BOTH the white pañuelo AND the red rose are REQUIRED, not optional. The face remains completely visible. Do not leave the original everyday hairstyle uncovered, omit the flower, or substitute a flower on the dress. destinations.hairPrompt: DRESS / FALLERA ensemble: authentic Valencian three-bun Fallera coiffure is MANDATORY: two proportionate braided spiral side coils (rodetes) by the ears/temples and a braided low rear bun (moño), with a traditional parting, gold peineta combs and matching hair ornaments. Show the characteristic side coils and combs clearly in the portrait; the rear bun may be partly hidden by the natural camera angle. Restyle the guest’s hair to this structure; a generic loose hairstyle, ponytail, topknot or ordinary single bun is NOT sufficient. Color-matched traditional hairpieces may complete the arrangement, without changing facial geometry, natural hairline or hair color. TROUSER / FALLERO ensemble: include the patterned regional head kerchief from the reference, tied neatly, with groomed visible hair. Do not put Fallera side coils on a guest wearing the trouser ensemble.
